scope: PCell arrays plus shared-frame serial peripherals; block estimate, not routed GDS or timing signoff; pads/ESD excluded.

assumptions.logic_inner_width: target edge minus 20 um; real cell widths packed by FFD
assumptions.search: 4..64 rows x 4..64 columns; both array and complete-frame orientations
assumptions.non_binary: Keep full address-width controller and all predecode terms; prune only unused final decoder outputs.
assumptions.analog: Column depth 120/150 um reserves final decoder, two PMOS prechargers and two NMOS column switches per column; common 11 MOS reserve 120x60 um.
assumptions.unimplemented_optimizations: No compact control decode, NAND/NOR decoder replacement, hierarchical column MUX or custom FF/MUX.

current_2x2_audit.scope: Fresh 2x2 schematic netlist; scalable control decode uses macro_model, not synthesis.
